problems.title: Recognition date does not guarantee absence from pretraining
problems.claim: Post-cutoff species recognition guarantees unseen concepts
problems.check: t_public<t_cutoff<t_recognize satisfies selection while permitting prior exposure. Primary taxonomy confirms previously recognized subspecies/historical material.
problems.result: Universal inference invalid; evaluated-model contamination not demonstrated.

correction.statement: Recently recognized taxa under documented cutoffs; remove unconditional unseen guarantee
correction.verification: Logical scope correction; no dataset audit

focused_check.note: Verified recognition after a cutoff is not sufficient for nonexposure: earlier public material can satisfy t_public < t_cutoff < t_recognition. The saved primary taxonomy evidence concerns pre-existing taxa and museum/photo records. Actual model contamination is not established; the new-label task and reported scores survive. The invalid core unseen-data guarantee supports Major.

problems.title: Printed score differs from release
problems.claim: Sum of pairwise ratios thresholded at0.6 measures discrimination
assumptions: All image pairs are processed successfully for the displayed release-average comparison; exception skipping is outside that normal path.
problems.check: With all pairs processed, equal 0.2 scores give printed D=1 and release average=0.5; target 0.1 versus confusing 0.2 gives printed 2/3 and release about 4.54e-5.
problems.result: The printed expression is not size normalized; the pinned release implements an all-pairs normalized softmax average on the successful-all-pairs path.
counterevidence: The probability-like interpretation and fixed thresholds suggest a normalized statistic; an explicit averaging statement in the paper concerns Generability, not D.
On the normal path where all image pairs are processed successfully, the release averages normalized softmax scores; historical experiment provenance remains unknown.
problems.core_dependency: Filtering specification; operative experimental damage unestablished

correction.statement: Specify the scale-100 all-pairs softmax average, its pair-count denominator and its exception behavior if this was the experimental statistic; bind the historical implementation before attributing benchmark effects.
correction.verification: Static formula and scalar diagnostics only

focused_check.note: Verified the n=2 equal-score witness (printed 1 versus release 0.5) and unequal-score witness (2/3 versus about 4.54e-5). Averaging characterizes the release only when all pairs are processed successfully; skipped exceptions can alter the effective denominator. The prose's explicit averaging belongs to Generability, not D. Minor specification mismatch remains; historical experimental harm is unproved.
